prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — first, do you mean UV tanning (tanning beds) or spray/sunless tanning? And what part of Columbus (ZIP or neighborhood) are you near? If you tell me that I can recommend specific salons to check out.

Meanwhile, here’s a quick guide so you can find the “best” salon for your needs:

What to decide first
- UV beds vs spray tan: spray tans are safest (no UV). UV beds increase skin cancer/aging risk and need careful limits.
- Location vs price vs experience: do you want a quick cheap tan, an expert airbrush/bronze, or a membership for frequent sessions?

How to find top salons
- Search: “best spray tan near [ZIP]” or “tanning salon near [neighborhood, Columbus, OH]” on Google Maps or Yelp.
- Sort by rating and read recent reviews (last 6–12 months).
- Check Instagram for before/after photos.
- Look for boutique studios with technician certifications for spray tans or for well-reviewed, modern equipment for UV.

What to ask/care about when you call or visit
- Are spray tans done by a certified technician? Ask to see before/after photos.
- Do they do a patch test for spray tans and what solution brands do they use?
- For UV: what type of beds/bulbs (high-pressure beds vs low), session times, and staff training?
- Cleanliness and ventilation: disposable head/eye covers, fresh towels, no lingering smell.
- Pricing, packages, membership terms, cancellation policy.
- Safety protocols: staff advice on tanning frequency and whether they advise clients with certain medications or skin conditions to avoid UV.

Safety tips
- If you choose UV, limit sessions per CDC/dermatologist guidance; use protective eyewear and follow recommended exposure times.
- Consider spray/tanning lotions instead of UV to avoid skin cancer and premature aging.
- Avoid tanning if you’re on photosensitizing meds (ask a pharmacist/doctor).

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll list 3–5 well-reviewed salons near you and what to look for in each.
